atoms.sound: A large demonstration in downtown Springfield is disrupting traffic in the area around the Illinois State Capitol., The Senate is currently trying to introduce a bill granting more power to law enforcement regarding immigration control. Following the incident last week in which a man died in the custody of law enforcement, thousands of protestors are now rallying to persuade the governor to vote against the bill.

b: ++The citizens of Springfield are protesting against a bill that would tighten immigration laws.
Traffic is being disrupted because of local festivities.
The Governor of Illinois has started a demonstration against a new bill.
A man was killed by law enforcement during a protest in Springfield.

atoms.sound: The Saint Bernard Primary School in East Salisbury has reported multiple cases of measles since Tuesday. At least twelve students have been infected so far, three of them are in a critical state. All are currently being treated in hospitals and the school remains closed until further notice. In a public address, the Minister of State for Health urges citizens to take preventative healthcare seriously and calls for parents to vaccinate their children, so that situations like this may be avoided in the future.

b: ++After a measles outbreak at a primary school, a politician emphasizes the importance of vaccinations.
A school has to permanently close because its students died of measles.
The Prime Minister is making vaccinations mandatory after a viral infection spread in a school.
Multiple schools are temporarily closing after their students have contracted smallpox.

atoms.sound: The Prime Minister has returned safely to Canberra this afternoon. He had flown to Italy on Wednesday for a meeting with the Pope in the Vatican. The two of them reportedly discussed global conflicts and what they could do to help those most affected by ongoing wars, terror and natural catastrophes. It is likely they will join forces to provide humanitarian aid overseas.

b: ++The Prime Minister of Australia and the Pope met in the Vatican to discuss international aid.
The Pope has visited Australia to promote humanitarian aid to its citizens.
The Vatican is planning to provide aid to Australia after it was hit by a natural catastrophe.
Australia and the Vatican intend to join forces and participate in wars overseas.
